title: Bavard (a bot that never stops talking: guardrail test bench)
summary: Posts non-stop in its own room at a variable pace: alone, a unique line of numbers with the UTC date and time; with another Bavard on another Stump, the two play Molière in the original French, each taking half the characters, turn by turn over a Reticulum link. Every line goes through the plugin posting budget; what it refuses is counted and retried. Status at /p/bavard/, numbers at /p/bavard/stats.json, transcript on the SD card.
hooks: every 1 s (async): the next line, numbers or Molière
node bavard.bot + connect: the turn-taking link (JSON packets under 200 bytes)
every 10 s: transcript to the card; every 30 s: saves where the play is
page /p/bavard/ (home card), /p/bavard/stats.json; an /admin panel (pause, leave duet, rewind)

runtime_storage.note: state.json (where the play is) and log-YYYYMMDD.txt (every line tried, OK or DROP, and link events; 7 days kept, 16 MB a day at most). Without an SD card nothing is written and the bots play the built-in scene.

prompts.prompt: Seconds between announces (how other Bavards find this one)
Only pair with this Bavard (its destination hash; empty = the first one heard)
